chapters: Goal
The initial value is f of zero.
Meaning
At time zero, no growth or decay has occurred.
Formula
In a times b to the x, a is the initial value.
Growth
Three hundred times one point zero four to the t starts at three hundred.
Decay
Two hundred forty times zero point seven five to the t starts at two hundred forty.
Tables
Find input zero in the table or graph.
Shift
Five times two to the x plus two starts at twenty.
Offset
Eight times one half to the x plus three starts at eleven.
Reverse
Divide seventy two by one point five squared to get thirty two.
Desmos
The graph of three hundred times one point zero four to the x crosses at three hundred.
Pitfalls
A shifted exponent changes the value at zero.
Review
Always evaluate at zero, then practice and test.
